author: Stahly
description:
81,200 square metres, 8 halls, and an endless array of Golden Demon cabinets that never failed to amaze. I spent two days at the Spiel in Essen, and barely scratched the surface. The world’s biggest board game fair has become a serious destination for miniature painters and wargamers too, with Games Workshop, Vallejo, Archon, and Trench Crusade all showing up in force. In this report, I take you the Squidmar Color launch and a quick lap through the board game halls, plus a few tips so you can plan your own visit next year.

The post Golden Demon, Squidmar Color, and Crimson Chalice: our Spiel Essen 2026 report appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Golden Demon, Squidmar Color, and Crimson Chalice: our Spiel Essen 2026 report
